subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Container Revolution
description: A 60-second lesson on The Container Revolution.

hook.text: Before 1956, loading a ship meant carrying thousands of individual crates by hand. It took days.

buildup.text: Trucker Malcolm McLean had a simple idea: put everything in identical metal boxes that stack.

discovery.text: His first container ship cut loading time from days to hours and costs by over 90 percent.

twist.text: Longshoremen fought containers for years—the technology destroyed their jobs almost overnight.

climax.text: Today 90% of global trade moves in containers. McLean's box reshaped the entire world economy.

punchline.text: A metal box changed the world more than most inventions.

quiz.question: What was revolutionary about shipping containers?
options: Standardized boxes that stacked, cutting costs by 90%
